summary: Iteration 4 fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 65/65 pytest passed (13 new tests in test_iteration4.py + 1 legacy test migrated to JSON body). Verified: FIX 1+2 POST /api/products/{id}/adjust accepts {stock_filled_delta, total_sold_delta, stock_empty_delta}, applies all 3 independently, and CLAMPS any counter to 0 when it would go negative (owner+warehouse only; cashier=403). FIX 3 POST /api/customers/{id}/deposit now JSON body {amount, reason}: positive top-up allowed for any auth user (logs in/topup_deposit cash entry), negative reduction OWNER-ONLY (cashier=403, driver=403), rejects (400) if resulting balance < 0, logs out/koreksi_deposit cash entry with reason in description. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Owner login OK; Stok tab -> adjust modal now renders 3 independent DeltaStepper rows with +/- buttons and editable signed number input (adj-filled/adj-sold/adj-empty with -minus/-plus). adj-empty correctly HIDDEN for refill category (verified on 'Air Isi Ulang RO 19L' where only adj-filled + adj-sold appear). Signed input allows negative deltas (adj-filled went to -1 via minus). save-adjust-button posts to /adjust and closes modal, product card auto-refreshes via load(). FIX 3 UI: on Pelanggan detail modal for OWNER, both topup-button + reduce-deposit-button visible; reduce opens modal (dep-amount-input + dep-reason-input) which submits successfully. For CASHIER, topup-button IS visible but reduce-deposit-button is HIDDEN (correct role guard). FIX 4 logout: tapping logout-button from Beranda header (owner) redirects to /login, login form re-appears (login-email-input visible), and re-login works.

issues: Direct navigation to /pelanggan while unauthenticated does NOT redirect to /login; the screen renders (empty state due to API 401s). Not in scope of the 4 iter-4 bugs but worth adding a route guard in (tabs)/_layout.
Pangkalan Jaya Abadi shows dozens of INV-260928-* transactions and inflated deposit (Rp1.224.000) from previous test runs; consider TEST_ prefix cleanup in a seed reset script.
